name: Floating Night: Sky Lantern Festival
promptTemplate: A panoramic night sky in {{sky_mood}} filled with {{lantern_density}} drifting sky lanterns swaying gently in {{wind_drift}} wind, their {{glow_size}} paper lanterns casting luminous warmth, with {{lake_reflection}} mirroring the ascending lights.

ui.title: Sky Lanterns
ui.tagline: Launch glowing paper lanterns into the night

sky_mood.hint: Shifts the background palette from twilight to obsidian

lantern_density.hint: Adjusts the total number of lanterns drifting aloft

wind_drift.hint: Directs the gentle breeze left or right

glow_size.hint: Expands the luminous halo surrounding each flame

lake_reflection.hint: Mirrors the floating lights across dark water below

release.hint: Sends your personal glowing lantern soaring upward

updraft.hint: Sweeps all lanterns up in a warm rising thermal

listing.blurb: A night sky fills with hundreds of warm glowing paper lanterns, drifting gently upward with lake reflections while the room releases custom lanterns into the breeze.
listing.prompt: A sky lantern festival: anyone can release a glowing paper lantern in their own colour, which rises slowly into the night, swaying, joining hundreds of others drifting up and away, a warm glow on the crowd below. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
